title: Absinthe Drip Cocktail (Czech Method) Recipe
ldInstructionsRaw: Flames and alcohol are a dangerous combination!
Place a sugar cube on a slotted absinthe spoon resting across the top of the glass
POUR the absinthe over the sugar cube into the glass
Light the absinthe-soaked cube and leave it to burn and caramelise
Using a bottle of chilled mineral water with a small hole in the cap, DRIP water over what's left of the sugar so it dissolves and drips into the glass
